title: MATQ-seq protocol
protocol: Prepare lysis solution containing 0.2% Triton-X in DEPC H₂O.
Add 1 μL of DTT, RnaseOUT, and primer mix to the lysis solution.
Pipette single cell into the lysis solution.
Briefly centrifuge the sample.
Incubate at 72°C for 3 minutes on a PCR block.
Quickly transfer to ice for at least 1 minute.
Add RT mix containing 5X RT buffer, DTT, RnaseOUT, Superscript III, and RNase-free H₂O.
Mix well using low retention tips.
Run reverse transcription program with specified temperature cycles.
Incubate at 50°C for 15 minutes after end of cycles.
Add T4 DNA polymerase to the sample.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 40 minutes.
Heat to 75°C for 20 minutes, then cool to 37°C for 40 minutes.
Incubate at 80°C for 20 minutes.
Add RnaseH and RnaseI to the sample.
Mix well and incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Heat to 72°C for 15 minutes.
Prepare TdT mix with buffer, dCTP, and terminal transferase.
Add TdT mix into the sample.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes followed by heat inactivation at 72°C for 15 minutes.
Add 1.25 μl of 10uM GAT21 primer into the sample.
Heat the block to 95°C for 1 minute.
Hold at 48°C and add Deepvent exo-DNA polymerase (New England Biolabs) 0.4 μL, mix well.
Perform 10 cycles of 48°C for 20 seconds followed by 72°C for 1 minute.
End with 72°C for 2 minutes then cool to 4°C forever.
Mix 13 μl of 10X Thermopol Buffer, 0.8 μl of 100uM GAT27 primer, and 3 μl of 10mM each dNTP in PCR grade water up to a total volume of 125 μl.
Add 3 μL Deepvent exo-DNA polymerase and split into 4 PCR tubes.
Incubate at 95°C for 30 seconds followed by 24 cycles of 95°C for 15 seconds, 62°C for 20 seconds, and 72°C for 2 minutes each cycle.
End with 72°C for 5 minutes then cool to 4°C forever.
Use Qiagen PCR purification kit to purify the end product.
Mix 200 ng of amplified cDNA with 5 μL of 10X Thermopol buffer, 1.25 μl dNTP, and 0.25 μl of 100mM 3NGAT24 primer in a total volume of 46.5 μL.
Add H2O to reach a final volume of 50 μL.
Incubate at 95°C for 30 seconds followed by 20 cycles of 62°C for 20 seconds and 72°C for 1 minute each cycle.
End with 72°C for 3 minutes then cool to 95°C for 30 seconds, repeat the previous step of 62°C for 20 seconds and 72°C for 1 minute for another 20 cycles.
Finally end with 72°C for 3 minutes followed by cooling to 4°C forever.
Use 1.2X Ampure XP beads (60 μL) to purify the product.
